releases.notes:
Client-side Fabric mod for Hypixel SkyBlock waypoint routes.

**Requires:** Minecraft 26.2, Fabric Loader 0.20.1+, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.2. OneConfig 1.9.5 is optional and adds a settings page.

Put `hollow-routes-1.4.0.jar` in `.minecraft/mods`. Open the settings with `/hr menu`, or see the [README](https://github.com/Lieno2/hollow-routes#readme) for all commands.

### Features
- **Dynamic routes:** waypoints stored relative to an anchor block, so one route works in every Crystal Hollows lobby. Rotations are supported.
- **Static routes:** fixed world coordinates for places that don't move.
- **Anchor auto-find:** a block fingerprint of the anchor lets the mod place the route by itself in new lobbies, in any rotation.
- **Auto mode:** detects where mobs (Automatons by default) newly spawn, then builds a short walking route through those points using real terrain. Spawn points that are too far out of the way, awkward to reach or unreachable are skipped (all tunable).
- **Smart routing:** move on when the waypoint's mob dies, wait for the kill, respawn timers that it learns, smart next-waypoint order, skipping spots another player is on, and a live walking path to the current waypoint.
- **Route editor:** top-down map, reordering, nudging, live preview in the world.
- **Import / export:** ColeWeight, Skytils and Skyblocker waypoint formats.
- **Stats HUD** (kills/hour, lap times, drops) and keybinds.

It only draws boxes, lines and text. It never moves, aims or clicks for you.

### Known limitations
- Nobody has run this release on Hypixel yet, so kill detection and spawn detection may need tuning. Please open an issue if something misbehaves.
